name: SkillsGrid
description: Grid of skill / tech logos arranged in 4 / 6 / 8 columns. Used on the about page and case studies to show capabilities or tooling at a glance.

ariaRequirements: Renders a `<section>` with an `aria-labelledby` heading so the grid is a labelled region.
Each logo carries an `alt` text describing the skill or tool; decorative-only logos are `aria-hidden`.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error).

forbiddenUse: Use for a small set of (≤ 4) capabilities — the grid rhythm collapses; use `Card` instead.
Mix logos and text in the same grid — pick one visual language.
dense: Grid of skill/tech logos in 4/6/8 columns; about-page module

usage.description: Logo grid of skills and technologies (4/6/8 column presets) for the about page. Keep logos alt-texted and monochrome where possible.
